steps.description: Verify the contacts list loads from GET /api/v1/people/contacts (PX-O-PPL-01).
steps.action: Observe the contact list rendered on the People page. Open browser DevTools Network tab and confirm a GET request to /api/v1/people/contacts was made and returned HTTP 200.
steps.expected: The response contains contact objects. If any contacts have an overdue flag, they appear at the top with an 'Overdue' badge. No 500 or 4xx errors appear.

steps.description: Verify empty state when no contacts exist, or verify list renders when contacts are present.
steps.action: Observe the People page. If the contact list is empty, verify an empty state message (e.g. 'No contacts yet') is shown. If contacts are present, verify the list renders with name and relationship information.
steps.expected: Either a meaningful empty state OR a populated list renders correctly. No blank white space or broken layout.

steps.description: Open a contact detail view (if any contacts exist).
steps.action: If at least one contact is present in the list, click on any contact entry to open its detail view. If the list is empty, mark this step as PASS — empty list is valid for the QA account.
steps.expected: If contacts exist: detail view loads with name, relationship type, email, and notes fields. HTTP 200 response in DevTools. If no contacts: PASS — empty state is acceptable.
